review_candidates.title: IT Support & Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Location: Remote Schedule: Eastern Time Business Hours Compensation: C$25,000 - $30,000 annually The Opportunity Langford Staffing is hiring an IT Support & Systems Administrator to support more than 100 remote users working across several technology-enabled and service-based companies. You will be responsible for employee access, account administration, technical support, phone systems, software permissions, security controls, and IT documentation. Administer Google Workspace, Outlook, Zoho, Zo
eligibility_evidence: This is a hands-on position for someone who can work independently, solve technical problems, protect company systems, and provide reliable support across a distributed international workforce.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on position for someone who can work independently, solve technical problems, protect company systems, and provide reliable support across a distributed international workforce. Enforce MFA, password, and access-control requirements. What You’ll Need At least three years of experience in IT support, systems administration, help-desk operations, or a similar technical role. Hands-on experience creating and removing user accounts, managing permissions, and supporting employee onboarding and offboarding. Strong equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered. MFA, password, and access-control requirements are consistently enforced. Remote Technology Requirements You must have: A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM Dual monitors Reliable internet with a speed of at least 100 Mbps Backup internet connectivity or a reliable power solution A webcam A noise-cancelling head
